description: Candidate Python codebases for adapter stress testing

projects.name: click
projects.notes: Fast clone, minimal deps. Good baseline test. Use --since HEAD~200 for sampling.

projects.name: attrs
projects.notes: Excellent code quality, property-based tests. Tests conditional imports and circular deps.

projects.name: structlog
projects.notes: Modern Python, async patterns. Fast clone. Tests composition-heavy code.

projects.name: httpx
projects.notes: Async HTTP client. Tests async discovery and third-party import resolution. Requires httpcore etc.

projects.name: requests
projects.notes: Classic HTTP library. Tests conditional dependency resolution. Sync counterpart to httpx.

projects.name: pydantic
projects.notes: Rust core (pydantic-core .so). Tests mixed Python/C codebase handling. Heavy generics.

projects.name: pandas
projects.notes: Massive codebase (~400k LOC, 1500+ files). Cython/C extensions. Long clone time. Max stress test.

projects.name: scikit-learn
projects.notes: Co-located tests per module. Cython extensions. Medium clone time. Unique test layout.
